summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything:** I had an agent trace the whole path (client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → auth middleware → `modules/watchlist` handlers → schema) read-only.
